meta.name: Kabisa Storefront
meta.description: Brand-led B2B healthcare procurement. Red Kabisa actions, navy navigation and a separate public application / approved buying workspace.
source_references: User October 2026 web-only and approval workflow brief

color.palette_type: Kabisa red, navy, white and cool grey
rules: Red for primary actions; navy for navigation and headings. Admin tokens are independent.
Semantic labels include words or icons; never color alone.
No fabricated stock counts, scarcity, reviews or facility statistics.

layout.product_grid: Existing phone/tablet columns; desktop auto-fill with 240px minimum card width. List view stays one column.
layout.container: Single outer gutter with no inherited horizontal padding; auth forms retain a 1120px maximum.

design_style.composition: Clear editorial public welcome, human pharmacy image, compact approved workspace and data-rich purchasing paths.
design_style.imagery: Generated pharmacist and fictional demo-product photos are explicitly labelled illustrative. Real stock uses admin product images; missing images have an honest fallback.
design_style.surfaces: White surfaces, cool grey section backgrounds, fine borders, restrained corners. No glass effects.
design_style.trust: Company TIN/licence and office contacts from existing settings; TMDA registration and prescription flags from products; account verification and real order status.

visual_effects.route_transition: Short Motion opacity/8px entrance keyed by pathname, with immediate reduced-motion state.
visual_effects.marketing: CSS hero choreography and once-only Motion section reveals. No scroll interception.
visual_effects.feedback: Product hover, async button press, server-confirmed add-to-basket check and cart count pulse.
visual_effects.loading: Skeleton cards and explicit pending/error states.
visual_effects.webgl: Omitted to preserve the commerce performance budget.
visual_effects.accessibility: MotionConfig reducedMotion=user plus CSS reduced-motion overrides; visible focus and named controls.

budgets.note: Targets require measurement on the deployed service; local verification evidence is recorded separately.
